title: Lowcountry Cowboy Fishing Charters
specs: Boat has T-top for shade and cover from rain
Boat has storage, two coolers (Yeti for drinks, another for fish/bait), live well, rod holders
Boat is v-hull, drafts little water to access shallow areas for redfish and other species
Custom non-skid gripping on deck to prevent slipping
Boat seats 6 people but preferably 4 for fishing trips; exceptions for fewer adults and more kids

blurb: Guests fish inshore and near shore waters around Hilton Head Island on a 22-foot Pathfinder boat with a Yamaha 150hp 4-stroke engine. The captain provides ice, bait, tackle, fishing license, first aid, life jackets, bottled water, and cleans the fish caught. The boat has shade, storage, coolers, a live well, and rod holders, and seats up to 6 but preferably 4 for fishing trips.
